english: Back to Account
afrikaans_before: Terug na Rekening
back_translation: Back to Account

english: Work with your saved sites through an assistant. Choose which sites it may use and disconnect it here whenever you need to.
afrikaans_before: Werk met jou gestoorde terreine deur 'n assistent. Kies watter terreine dit mag gebruik en ontkoppel dit hier wanneer jy ook al nodig het.
back_translation: Work with your saved sites through an assistant. Choose which sites it may use and disconnect it here whenever you need to.

english: Checking your account…
afrikaans_before: Kontroleer tans jou rekening…
back_translation: Checking your account…

english: Sign in to your ImbewuField account
afrikaans_before: Meld aan by jou ImbewuField-rekening
back_translation: Sign in to your ImbewuField account

english: Your assistant receives its own scoped connection. It does not receive your password.
afrikaans_before: Jou assistent kry sy eie beperkte verbinding. Dit kry nie jou wagwoord nie.
back_translation: Your assistant gets its own limited connection. It does not get your password.

english: Continue with Google
afrikaans_before: Gaan voort met Google
back_translation: Continue with Google

english: Password
afrikaans_before: Wagwoord
back_translation: Password

english: Loading your sites and connections…
afrikaans_before: Laai tans jou terreine en verbindings…
back_translation: Loading your sites and connections…

english: Your account
afrikaans_before: Jou rekening
back_translation: Your account

english: Personal account
afrikaans_before: Persoonlike rekening
back_translation: Personal account

english: Connect {name}
afrikaans_before: Koppel {name}
back_translation: Connect {name}

english: After you approve, return to
afrikaans_before: Nadat jy goedkeur, keer terug na
back_translation: After you approve, return to

english: Only continue if you started this connection and recognise that destination.
afrikaans_before: Gaan net voort as jy hierdie verbinding begin het en die bestemming herken.
back_translation: Only continue if you started this connection and recognise the destination.

english: Choose sites to share with this assistant
afrikaans_before: Kies terreine om met hierdie assistent te deel
back_translation: Choose sites to share with this assistant

english: No saved sites are synced to this account yet. You may connect with no sites, then save a site in the app and reconnect to select it.
afrikaans_before: Nog geen gestoorde terreine is met hierdie rekening gesinkroniseer nie. Jy kan sonder terreine koppel, dan 'n terrein in die toepassing stoor en weer koppel om dit te kies.
back_translation: No saved sites have been synchronised with this account yet. You can connect without sites, then save a site in the app and connect again to choose it.

english: This does not grant access to your Gmail, Drive or computer. New sites need a new connection decision. Connections expire after 90 days; access tokens last one hour.
afrikaans_before: Dit gee nie toegang tot jou Gmail, Drive of rekenaar nie. Nuwe terreine het 'n nuwe verbindingsbesluit nodig. Verbindings verval ná 90 dae; toegangstekens hou een uur.
back_translation: It does not give access to your Gmail, Drive or computer. New sites need a new connection decision. Connections expire after 90 days; access tokens last one hour.

english: Allow selected access
afrikaans_before: Laat gekose toegang toe
back_translation: Allow selected access

english: Cancel connection
afrikaans_before: Kanselleer verbinding
back_translation: Cancel connection

english: Connected assistants
afrikaans_before: Gekoppelde assistente
back_translation: Connected assistants

english: {n} selected sites · expires {date}
afrikaans_before: {n} gekose terreine · verval op {date}
back_translation: {n} selected sites · expires on {date}

english: Disconnect {name}
afrikaans_before: Ontkoppel {name}
back_translation: Disconnect {name}

english: No active assistant connections.
afrikaans_before: Geen aktiewe assistentverbindings nie.
back_translation: No active assistant connections.

english: Site originals
afrikaans_before: Terrein-oorspronklikes
back_translation: Site originals

english: Imported originals keep their source, byte count and fingerprint. They are separate from the small evidence thumbnails stored on a device.
afrikaans_before: Ingevoerde oorspronklikes behou hul bron, greeptelling en vingerafdruk. Hulle is apart van die klein bewysduimnaels wat op 'n toestel gestoor word.
back_translation: Imported originals keep their source, byte count and fingerprint. They are separate from the small proof thumbnails stored on a device.

english: Completed imports remain in ImbewuField after the chat closes.
afrikaans_before: Voltooide invoere bly in ImbewuField nadat die klets gesluit is.
back_translation: Completed imports stay in ImbewuField after the chat is closed.

english: {size} bytes · {mime}
afrikaans_before: {size} grepe · {mime}
back_translation: {size} bytes · {mime}

english: Import authorisation: {authorisation}
afrikaans_before: Invoermagtiging: {authorisation}
back_translation: Import authorisation: {authorisation}

english: Open original {name}
afrikaans_before: Maak oorspronklike {name} oop
back_translation: Open original {name}

english: No originals are attached to this site.
afrikaans_before: Geen oorspronklikes is aan hierdie terrein geheg nie.
back_translation: No originals are attached to this site.

english: Historical photo registration draft
afrikaans_before: Konsep vir passing van historiese foto
back_translation: Draft for fitting a historical photo

english: Review registered photograph
afrikaans_before: Hersien die gepaste foto
back_translation: Review the fitted photo

english: {name} · Original bytes verified
afrikaans_before: {name} · Oorspronklike grepe geverifieer
back_translation: {name} · Original bytes verified

english: Connect an MCP-compatible assistant
afrikaans_before: Koppel 'n MCP-versoenbare assistent
back_translation: Connect an MCP-compatible assistant

english: Use the ImbewuField private plugin, or add the following Streamable HTTP endpoint in a host that supports OAuth and remote MCP:
afrikaans_before: Gebruik die private ImbewuField-inprop, of voeg die volgende Streamable HTTP-eindpunt by in 'n gasheer wat OAuth en afstand-MCP ondersteun:
back_translation: Use the private ImbewuField plug-in, or add the following Streamable HTTP endpoint in a host that supports OAuth and remote MCP:

english: Your host should open this app’s sign-in and site-selection page. An installed plugin card alone does not mean the connection is authenticated.
afrikaans_before: Jou gasheer moet hierdie toepassing se aanmeld- en terreinkiesbladsy oopmaak. 'n Geïnstalleerde inpropkaart alleen beteken nie die verbinding is geverifieer nie.
back_translation: Your host must open this app's sign-in and site-selection page. An installed plug-in card alone does not mean the connection is verified.
note: minor: back-translated as "verified" for "authenticated"; same meaning for a user, no change

english: Photo preview is unavailable on this device.
afrikaans_before: Fotovoorskou is nie op hierdie toestel beskikbaar nie.
back_translation: Photo preview is not available on this device.

english: The original photo could not be displayed.
afrikaans_before: Die oorspronklike foto kon nie gewys word nie.
back_translation: The original photo could not be shown.

english: Registered original photograph with saved design outlines and observed control points
afrikaans_before: Gepaste oorspronklike foto met gestoorde ontwerpomtrekke en waargenome beheerpunte
back_translation: Fitted original photo with saved design outlines and observed control points

english: Matching error: {rms} pixels RMS; {max} pixels maximum.
afrikaans_before: Passingsfout: {rms} piksels RMS; {max} piksels maksimum.
back_translation: Fit error: {rms} pixels RMS; {max} pixels maximum.

english: White circles mark matched controls. Green outlines show the saved design. Empty ground stays blank.
afrikaans_before: Wit sirkels merk gepaste beheerpunte. Groen omtrekke wys die gestoorde ontwerp. Leë grond bly leeg.
back_translation: White circles mark fitted control points. Green outlines show the saved design. Empty ground stays empty.

english: Needs visual review · Your current maps and saved geometry are unchanged.
afrikaans_before: Moet visueel nagegaan word · Jou huidige kaarte en gestoorde meetkunde is onveranderd.
back_translation: Needs visual checking · Your current maps and saved geometry are unchanged.

english: Sector maps show clearer wind and rain symbols, with slope and contours kept visible.
afrikaans_before: Sector-kaarte wys duideliker wind- en reënsimbole, met helling en hoogtelyne wat sigbaar bly.
back_translation: Sector maps show clearer wind and rain symbols, with slope and contours remaining visible.

english: Sector illustrations have bolder arrows, larger sun symbols and a clearer map key.
afrikaans_before: Sector-illustrasies het dikker pyle, groter sonsimbole en 'n duideliker kaartlegende.
back_translation: Sector illustrations have thicker arrows, bigger sun symbols and a clearer map legend.

english: Sector illustrations now show bolder terrain contours and matching key lines.
afrikaans_before: Sector-illustrasies wys nou dikker terreinhoogtelyne en ooreenstemmende legendelyne.
back_translation: Sector illustrations now show thicker terrain contours and matching legend lines.

english: Sector illustrations keep richer colour, with larger labels and clearer contours.
afrikaans_before: Sector-illustrasies behou ryker kleur, met groter etikette en duideliker hoogtelyne.
back_translation: Sector illustrations keep richer colour, with bigger labels and clearer contours.

english: Important updates include a short animation you can pause and replay.
afrikaans_before: Belangrike opdaterings sluit 'n kort animasie in wat jy kan onderbreek en herspeel.
back_translation: Important updates include a short animation you can interrupt and replay.

english: Sector maps use a quieter background and clearer sun, wind and fire marks.
afrikaans_before: Sector-kaarte gebruik 'n rustiger agtergrond en duideliker son-, wind- en vuurmerke.
back_translation: Sector maps use a calmer background and clearer sun, wind and fire marks.

english: Choose which saved sites an assistant can use, and disconnect it in Settings.
afrikaans_before: Kies watter gestoorde terreine 'n assistent kan gebruik, en ontkoppel dit in Instellings.
back_translation: Choose which saved sites an assistant can use, and disconnect it in Settings.

english: Keep original site photos and PDFs with their source and import history.
afrikaans_before: Hou oorspronklike terreinfoto's en PDF's saam met hul bron en invoergeskiedenis.
back_translation: Keep original site photos and PDFs together with their source and import history.

english: Review historical photo registration drafts without moving saved map features.
afrikaans_before: Hersien konsepte vir die passing van historiese foto's sonder om gestoorde kaartkenmerke te skuif.
back_translation: Review drafts for fitting historical photos without moving saved map features.

english: Manage assistant access
afrikaans_before: Bestuur assistenttoegang
back_translation: Manage assistant access

english: Settings → Assistant connections
afrikaans_before: Instellings → Assistentverbindings
back_translation: Settings → Assistant connections

english: Review connected assistants, selected sites and imported originals.
afrikaans_before: Hersien gekoppelde assistente, gekose terreine en ingevoerde oorspronklikes.
back_translation: Review connected assistants, selected sites and imported originals.

english: Check your saved map
afrikaans_before: Kontroleer jou gestoorde kaart
back_translation: Check your saved map

english: Site design
afrikaans_before: Terreinontwerp
back_translation: Site design

english: Review the same site before applying assistant edits or comparing a historical photograph.
afrikaans_before: Hersien dieselfde terrein voordat jy assistentwysigings toepas of 'n historiese foto vergelyk.
back_translation: Review the same site before you apply assistant edits or compare a historical photo.

english: Open Terrain & Sections for the two cuts and extra contour detail.
afrikaans_before: Maak Terrain & Sections oop vir die twee deursnitte en ekstra hoogtelynbesonderhede.
back_translation: Open Terrain & Sections for the two cross-sections and extra contour detail.

english: Sector illustrations have lighter arrows, clearer contours and a shorter map key.
afrikaans_before: Sector-illustrasies het ligter pyle, duideliker hoogtelyne en 'n korter kaartlegende.
back_translation: Sector illustrations have lighter arrows, clearer contours and a shorter map legend.

english: Terrain profiles show sampled elevation and classroom positions at the plan scale.
afrikaans_before: Terreinprofiele wys gemonsterde hoogte en klaskamerposisies teen die planskaal.
back_translation: Terrain profiles show sampled elevation and classroom positions against the plan scale.
note: English itself says "classroom positions"; drafted faithfully

english: Review the shade cover
afrikaans_before: Hersien die skadubedekking
back_translation: Review the shade coverage

english: Open Structures, then reassemble the saved AI artwork to show its shade cover.
afrikaans_before: Maak Structures oop en stel dan die gestoorde AI-kunswerk weer saam om sy skadubedekking te wys.
back_translation: Open Structures, then recompose the saved AI artwork to show its shade coverage.

english: Structures maps show recorded shade cloth over the illustrated beds.
afrikaans_before: Structures-kaarte wys aangetekende skadunet oor die geïllustreerde beddings.
back_translation: Structures maps show recorded shade net over the illustrated beds.

english: Sector maps use regional overview contours, with an optional A–B terrain profile.
afrikaans_before: Sector-kaarte gebruik streeksoorsig-hoogtelyne, met 'n opsionele A–B-terreinprofiel.
back_translation: Sector maps use regional overview contours, with an optional A–B terrain profile.

english: Exact and illustrated Water maps now show the same water budget.
afrikaans_before: Presiese en geïllustreerde Water-kaarte wys nou dieselfde waterbegroting.
back_translation: Precise and illustrated Water maps now show the same water budget.

english: Zone maps trim blurry aerial edges when the photo covers the site.
afrikaans_before: Zone-kaarte sny vaag lugfotorande af wanneer die foto die terrein dek.
back_translation: Zone maps crop blurry aerial-photo edges when the photo covers the site.

english: Existing Site labels and legend now use matching symbols.
afrikaans_before: Existing Site-etikette en -legende gebruik nou ooreenstemmende simbole.
back_translation: Existing Site labels and legend now use matching symbols.

english: Choose area names or a numbered key on the historical Existing Site map.
afrikaans_before: Kies areanames of 'n genommerde legende op die historiese Existing Site-kaart.
back_translation: Choose area names or a numbered legend on the historical Existing Site map.

english: Ubhejane Site and Sector maps can show the before-works archive photograph.
afrikaans_before: Ubhejane Site- en Sector-kaarte kan die argieffoto van voor die werke wys.
back_translation: Ubhejane Site and Sector maps can show the archive photo from before the works.

english: AI maps start with available aerial imagery; you can still choose plain paper.
afrikaans_before: AI-kaarte begin met beskikbare lugbeelde; jy kan steeds gewone papier kies.
back_translation: AI maps begin with available aerial imagery; you can still choose plain paper.

english: AI Site and Sector maps keep their painted detail, with fewer photo strips.
afrikaans_before: AI Site- en Sector-kaarte behou hul geskilderde besonderhede, met minder fotostroke.
back_translation: AI Site and Sector maps keep their painted detail, with fewer photo strokes.

english: Phasing keeps painted artwork; the app adds its schedule, pins and scale.
afrikaans_before: Phasing behou geskilderde kunswerk; die toepassing voeg sy skedule, speldjies en skaal by.
back_translation: Phasing keeps painted artwork; the app adds its schedule, pins and scale.

english: Paper-friendly map styles start on white and keep your chosen background.
afrikaans_before: Papiervriendelike kaartstyle begin op wit en behou jou gekose agtergrond.
back_translation: Paper-friendly map styles start on white and keep your chosen background.

english: Review the AI map finish
afrikaans_before: Hersien die AI-kaart se afwerking
back_translation: Review the AI map's finish

english: Site design → Glossy
afrikaans_before: Terreinontwerp → Glossy
back_translation: Site design → Glossy

english: Choose a sheet and style. Paper-friendly styles start on white unless you choose another background.
afrikaans_before: Kies 'n blad en styl. Papiervriendelike style begin op wit tensy jy 'n ander agtergrond kies.
back_translation: Choose a sheet and style. Paper-friendly styles start on white unless you choose another background.

english: Compare with your exact plan
afrikaans_before: Vergelyk met jou presiese plan
back_translation: Compare with your precise plan

english: Site design → Saved maps
afrikaans_before: Terreinontwerp → Gestoorde kaarte
back_translation: Site design → Saved maps

english: Open the saved exact plan beside its AI illustration. Check bed corners, buildings and plants before using the illustration.
afrikaans_before: Maak die gestoorde presiese plan langs sy AI-illustrasie oop. Kontroleer beddinghoeke, geboue en plante voordat jy die illustrasie gebruik.
back_translation: Open the saved precise plan next to its AI illustration. Check bed angles, buildings and plants before you use the illustration.

english: Explore international reference drafts; local farming advice remains unavailable.
afrikaans_before: Verken internasionale verwysingskonsepte; plaaslike boerderyraad bly onbeskikbaar.
back_translation: Explore international reference drafts; local farming advice remains unavailable.

english: Review international references
afrikaans_before: Hersien internasionale verwysings
back_translation: Review international references

english: International foundation
afrikaans_before: Internasionale grondslag
back_translation: International foundation

english: Compare country evidence, language drafts and fictional project examples.
afrikaans_before: Vergelyk landbewyse, taalkonsepte en fiktiewe projekvoorbeelde.
back_translation: Compare country evidence, language drafts and fictional project examples.

english: Plan seedlings, trays and nursery space with your own equipment and estimates.
afrikaans_before: Beplan saailinge, trooie en kwekerygrootte met jou eie toerusting en skattings.
back_translation: Plan seedlings, trays and nursery size with your own equipment and estimates.

english: Check nursery space
afrikaans_before: Kontroleer kwekerygrootte
back_translation: Check nursery size

english: Crop planner → Nursery planner
afrikaans_before: Gewasbeplanner → Kwekerybeplanner
back_translation: Crop planner → Nursery planner

english: Add your tray sizes, usable nursery surface and crop estimates. Review overlapping demand and missing information before adding automatic sowings.
afrikaans_before: Voeg jou trooigroottes, bruikbare kwekeryoppervlak en gewasskattings by. Hersien oorvleuelende aanvraag en ontbrekende inligting voordat jy outomatiese saaiings byvoeg.
back_translation: Add your tray sizes, usable nursery area and crop estimates. Review overlapping demand and missing information before you add automatic sowings.

english: Choose Editorial Atlas for a lighter AI style and a circular Sector diagram.
afrikaans_before: Kies Editorial Atlas vir 'n ligter AI-styl en 'n ronde Sector-diagram.
back_translation: Choose Editorial Atlas for a lighter AI style and a round Sector diagram.

english: Maps have finer boundaries with round posts and clearer Earthworks labels.
afrikaans_before: Kaarte het fyner grense met ronde pale en duideliker Earthworks-etikette.
back_translation: Maps have finer boundaries with round posts and clearer Earthworks labels.

english: Terrain maps show elevation, slope percentage and degrees from local terrain data.
afrikaans_before: Terreinkaarte wys hoogte, hellingspersentasie en grade uit plaaslike terreindata.
back_translation: Terrain maps show elevation, slope percentage and degrees from local terrain data.
